The Ala Plaza was a site of the first Freemason large temple in Texas, which has religious significance. They chose this place for what seemed like a ritual sacrifice. The Freemasons are very important; some say they control America.

Leo Harvey Oswald fired three shots. One bullet hit JFK and ricocheted to also injure Governor Connelly. The Warren Commission called it the "magic bullet." Leo Harvey Oswald was arrested and charged with killing the president. Jack Ruby ambushed him in court, shooting him point blank. How did Ruby get so close? There was no security.

Oswald was held by two much larger police officers, making it hard for him to dodge the bullet. His reaction is strange; a trained officer would push or draw his gun but he froze. This doesn't align with his training. I'm not saying this is a conspiracy, but these discrepancies raise questions.

JFK's brother, Robert F. Kennedy, also ran for president in 1968 and was killed too. Sirhan Sirhan was charged and remains in prison today. He claims he didn't do it. 

In 2001, after the Twin Towers fell, concrete and steel debris were shipped to China without an investigation. A month later, all that remained was sent off. Historically, fires never brought down skyscrapers, but on 9/11, they did. The theory is that the jet hit and caused explosions that melted the steel frame, leading to a "pancake effect." Three buildings were brought down by two planes.

The debris of the Twin Towers revealed no bodies or luggage but found passports from 19 hijackers. Their boarding passes were recovered in the wreckage. The government concluded they acted alone and got lucky.
